title: Lead Quality Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and quality-driven
**Lead Quality Analyst**
to lead quality assurance and testing activities for large-scale Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management (ESM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Conversational Agentic Platform initiatives.
  
  
The Lead Quality Analyst will be responsible for defining quality strategy, governing testing practices, mentoring Quality Analysts, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, security, integration, and user experience expectations.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of quality leadership, business process understanding, stakeholder management, and hands-on testing expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Salesforce Leads, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders to establish a quality-first culture across all delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Leadership & Governance**

* Lead quality assurance activities across multiple Salesforce and ITSM workstreams.
* Define quality strategies, test governance processes, standards, and best practices.
* Establish testing frameworks, review processes, quality metrics, and release readiness criteria.
* Act as the primary quality escalation point for delivery teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality engineering practices.
* Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across all project phases.

**Test Strategy & Planning**

* Define comprehensive testing strategies covering:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ Regression Testing
+ User Acceptance Testing
+ Release Validation

* Review and approve test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution results.
* Ensure complete traceability between requirements and testing outcomes.
* Drive risk-based testing approaches for complex enterprise implementations.

**Salesforce & ITSM Solution Validation**

* Lead validation activities for solutions involving:

+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Agentforce
+ Enterprise Service Management
+ ITSM Platforms

* Validate business processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management
+ Employee Service Delivery

* Ensure solutions meet business objectives, customer requirements, and compliance expectations.

**Integration & Enterprise Testing**

* Lead testing of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, ERP, HR, Monitoring, and third-party applications.
* Establish integration testing standards and validation approaches.
* Ensure data integrity, synchronization, security, and business continuity across connected platforms.
* Oversee complex end-to-end business process validation.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Quality Analysts across multiple projects.
* Review and approve testing deliverables.
* Provide coaching on testing methodologies, automation adoption, and quality best practices.
* Support capability development and certification initiatives.
* Foster a quality-first mindset across business and technical teams.

**UAT & Release Management**

* Guide UAT planning and business validation activities.
* Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes.
* Participate in release governance and production readiness reviews.
* Ensure quality criteria are achieved prior to production deployments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Define testing approaches for Agentforce, Conversational AI, and AI-powered service experiences.
* Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities.
* Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7–10 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise environments.
* Minimum 2–3 years leading QA teams or testing workstreams.
* Strong experience testing Salesforce and/or Enterprise Service Management platforms.
* Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ UAT
+ Defect Management
+ Quality Metrics
+ Root Cause Analysis

* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting.
* Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models.
* Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience validating ITSM, CMDB, or IT Asset Management implementations.
* Experience with API and MuleSoft integration testing.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and test automation strategies.
* Salesforce, ISTQB, Quality Engineering, or related certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Experience testing Agentforce implementations.
* Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Service Management operating models.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes.
* Can lead quality governance across enterprise programs.
* Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Champion quality engineering and innovation.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead quality assurance efforts for strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management initiatives.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms.
* Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects.
* Mentor and develop future quality leaders within the organization.
* Collaborate with business leaders, architects, developers, and product teams driving enterprise transformation.
* Join a high-growth organization where quality, innovation, and customer experience are central to success.
* Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are an experienced
**Lead Quality Analyst**
who combines strong testing expertise with leadership, governance, and mentoring capabilities, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering next-generation
**Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms**
, ensuring exceptional quality, business value, and customer experience at every stage of the delivery lifecycle.

**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

***Who We Are***
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.
   

  

***What We’re Looking For***
 The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.
   

  

***What’s in it for you?***
*The People* 
 \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.
   

  

*The Growth* 
 \- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

*The Technology* 
 \- You’ll get the chance to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

***What You’ll Do***
* Analyzing debug log files and crash analysis, bug identification, suggesting fixes and coordinating with the engineering team to implement the bug fixes in future releases for MobiControl products
* Identifying MobiControl server\-side and client\-side limitations based on information gathered from the customer’s production environment
* Working with internal teams to develop, maintain, and update diagnostic tools internally to check configuration\-related issues and log files for multiple mobile platforms
* Troubleshooting, researching, and coordinating with frontline teams to evaluate the issue and narrow down the process/procedure or method that is causing the failure
* Identifying issues that are caused by the latest operating system or product updates, and coordinating with the engineering team to provide patches for fixing the issues

* Knowledge and experience with various mobile platforms such as Android, Android Enterprise, and iOS
* Knowledgeable in Java/Android/Kotlin, C\#, .NET, and development platforms such as Android Studio, and Visual Studio
* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures
* Excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with building custom applications for various use/business cases
